title: Iddata Source
text: Import time-domain data stored in iddata object in MATLAB workspace, 2 outputs; {IDDATA object} sets the time-domain data to be imported iddata and {Start time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: Input data stored in iddata object scalar | vector

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Output data stored in iddata object scalar | vector

params.name: IDDATA object
params.values: Time-domain data to be imported iddata(1,1) (default) | iddata object

params.name: Start time
params.values: Start time for signals in iddata object -1 (default) | non-negative real scalar
